_about: Demo calls for a video (scripts/demo_record.js): a caller voiced by Orpheus (scripts/demo_callers.js renders the lines) talks to the app through a stand-in microphone, and the app window is recorded with both voices. Each turn: say, then wait `pause` ms after the line ends. whenAssistantTalkingMs: start the line once the assistant has been speaking that long (a cut-in). afterAssistantQuietMs: start it once the assistant has spoken and then been quiet that long (at most `maxWaitMs`).

scenarios.name: backchannel
scenarios.title: It listens while you talk
scenarios.caption: A long story: it says "mm-hm" and "yeah" as you go, without taking over, then reacts when you finish.

turns.say: So this morning was a total disaster. I was trying to get out the door, and I couldn't find my keys anywhere,
so I'm looking in the couch, in the kitchen, in my jacket pockets, and then I realize the dog had them,
like he'd carried them into his bed. And by then I'm late, so I'm running for the bus, and of course it pulls away right as I get there.

scenarios.name: cut-in
scenarios.title: Talk over it and it stops
scenarios.caption: Interrupt the story with a question: it stops within a second, answers, then picks the story back up.

turns.say: Can you tell me a story about a fox? A long one, something cozy. I'm just listening.
Wait, what was the fox's name?

scenarios.name: thinking-pause
scenarios.title: It waits while you think
scenarios.caption: Trail off mid-sentence to find a word: it waits through the pause instead of jumping in.

turns.say: I'm trying to remember the name of, um,
what's the tallest mountain in the world?

scenarios.name: warning
scenarios.title: It speaks up when it matters
scenarios.caption: Mention a dangerous plan: it cuts in with a warning instead of just agreeing.

turns.say: Hey, I'm cleaning the bathroom right now and I've got some bleach here.
And I'm going to mix it with the ammonia cleaner so it gets extra strong. Good idea, right?

scenarios.name: quiet
scenarios.title: It picks the call back up
scenarios.caption: Go quiet for a while: it says something to keep the conversation going, like a friend would.

turns.say: Hey! Not much going on here, just relaxing on the couch.

scenarios.name: quick
scenarios.title: Quick back-and-forth
scenarios.caption: Short questions get short answers, right away.

turns.say: And what's the capital of Japan?
